---
title: "Development"
---

## Project Layout

- `smaccl/`: package source code and kernels
- `tests/`: test suite
- `notebooks/`: exploratory notebooks
- `docs/`: Quarto documentation source

## Local Development

Install in editable mode:

```bash
uv venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install -e .
```

Run tests:

```bash
pytest tests/
```

## OpenCL Notes

The correction backend relies on OpenCL. Development machines need:

- A working OpenCL ICD/driver
- Python bindings (`pyopencl`) available in the environment

## Documentation Workflow

Build docs:

```bash
quarto render docs
```

Live preview:

```bash
quarto preview docs
```

## Contribution Guidance

- Keep configuration examples runnable with clear paths
- Add/adjust tests with code changes where practical
- Update Quarto docs when changing processing logic or interfaces
